'''Grania''' was a young platinum blonde [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] from [[Brentaal IV/Legends|Brentaal IV]] who lived during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].

==Biography==
Grania was one of [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Lon Isoto]]'s concubines. On one occasion shortly before the [[Battle of Brentaal IV (Galactic Civil War)|Battle of Brentaal IV]], he offered her to [[Baron/Legends|Baron]] [[Soontir Fel/Legends|Soontir Fel]], who politely refused.

In reality, she was one of [[Ysanne Isard]]'s spies, and killed Isoto on her orders as part of [[Project Ambition]] following the Battle of Brentaal IV. As part of her disguise, she gave herself up to the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] afterwards, who believed her to be no more than Isoto's plaything.
